title: Smart Money Radar
description: Choose one workflow. Smart Money Moves (default) returns cross-fund convergence for the latest 13F quarter.

action.title: What do you want to see?
enumTitles: Which tracked funds hold a security?
action.description: top_moves = what the tracked funds are all buying/selling this quarter. fund_flows = single-fund QoQ report. stock_holdings = holdings of one security across the basket. insider_buys = open-market Form 4 purchases with cluster detection.

min_funds.title: Convergence threshold (funds)
min_funds.description: Mark a move as 'convergence' when at least this many tracked funds moved the same way.

include_etfs.title: Include ETF positions
include_etfs.description: ETF holdings are usually passive allocation, not stock-picking signals. Off by default.

fund.title: Fund (for fund_flows)
fund.description: Basket slug (berkshire, bridgewater, renaissance, citadel, tiger, appaloosa, pershing, greenlight, d1, baillie, duquesne, thirdpoint, point72, soros, valueact, starboard, coatue), official fund name, CIK, or any other fund name (resolved via EDGAR).

symbol.title: Security (for stock_holdings)
symbol.description: Ticker, CUSIP, or issuer name. Example: NVDA, 037833100, or 'Apple Inc'.

days_back.title: Insider lookback window (days)
days_back.description: How many calendar days back to scan Form 4 filings.

min_value_usd.title: Minimum purchase value (USD)
min_value_usd.description: Only open-market purchases at least this large are returned.
